original.target_description: Full original paper not acquired within acquisition budget.

replication.target_description: Comparison of number of violent charges for ASPD+PSY diagnosis versus controls. Adult male county-jail inmates in Illinois; standard diagnostic groups; pairwise criminal-history test, not severe-ASPD sensitivity analysis.

n.sample_role: Participants in each comparison group, respectively: ASPD + PSY; control. Group sizes are printed separately; not a derived combined n.
n.exclusions: Paper p. 334 excludes neurocognitive medication effects, psychotic symptoms, inability to read English, estimated IQ below 70, and missing prior-charge information. Left-handedness exclusion applies only to cognitive analyses. P. 335: criminal-analysis outliers in 12 controls, 9 ASPD-only and 4 ASPD + PSY were transformed, not removed.
n.location: p. 337, Table 2 group headers; pp. 334–335, Participants and Preliminary Analyses

reported_success.quote: Results replicate the findings of […] Kosson, Lorenz, and Newman (2006)

notes: Original acquisition failed: DOI tool inaccessible; OpenAlex supplies no open-access location; historical author-hosted PDF returned 404 after correcting an SSL verification failure; CiteSeer alternative returned 429. No original statistic inferred from replication. Replication title, authors and DOI verified against full-paper HTML mirror; cached web parse retains two-column interleaving. Success is the authors’ paper-level narrative verdict, not an independently inferred effect-level outcome. Printed d and p are from the same pairwise test. Standard groups retained; severe-ASPD supplementary tests were not substituted.
